parent_objective: audit M1686 bounded public routing smoke before full measured rollout
blocked_by: need result audit before full 864-cell measured rollout or controller-family interpretation

public_gates: M1686 summary and required CSV artifacts must exist
M1686 must have 48 episodes, 12 profiles, and at least 4 specs
M1686 selected metrics must be finite
M1686 forbidden guardrails must remain clean
M1687 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1687 must not claim controller-family ranking paper-level evidence or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the 48-episode routing smoke before deciding whether full measured rollout is admissible
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no new rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1686 artifacts are missing
stop if M1686 counts or finite metrics fail
stop if M1686 guardrails are violated
stop if runner design cannot safely scale to full rollout without ambiguity
fallback_plan: route to runner repair if artifacts or metrics are incomplete
route to measured-execution redesign if selected specs are insufficient
route to full measured rollout design only if audit passes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1686 produced a measured public routing-smoke result

admission_evidence: M1686 produced summary episode profile and spec artifacts with public routing-smoke claim scope
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1687 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: next full-rollout or repair route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1687 audits only routing/plumbing and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must preserve the no-ranking and no-self-ID claim boundary
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If smoke artifacts are incomplete or ambiguous, record that as process evidence and route to repair before full rollout.
allowed_claims: no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1686 is a clean routing-smoke pass that can safely admit a separately designed full public measured rollout.
success_criteria: M1686 summary and CSV artifacts are readable
audit preserves no controller-ranking no paper-level and no level3 self-ID claim boundary
failure_criteria: M1686 counts or finite metrics fail
audit claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1686 routing smoke artifacts and decide full-rollout or repair route

decision_rule: M1687 passes if it audits M1686 as complete clean routing-smoke evidence and routes explicitly to full-rollout design or repair.
